marina_onboard: Hey team, hit two onboarding nits in the node quickstart I wanted to surface: intermittent RequestId=null on the very first http log lines, and a sample user accidentally printed an API-like token containing a zero-width joiner so our regex didn't catch it. bad first-run experience.

raj_sdk: thanks, can you paste the minimal repro + exact console output?

marina_onboard: repro is just sample-app unchanged. we call `rws.init({otel:true, logging:{level:'debug', redaction:[/sk_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{12,}/]}})` then `app.use(rws.middleware.logger)` and have a handler that does `console.log('payload', req.body)` before `req.log.info`. sample logs: 
```
2026-07-04T14:12:01Z INFO  Starting sample app
2026-07-04T14:12:01Z DEBUG init otel hooks attached
2026-07-04T14:12:01Z INFO  RequestId=null POST /v1/webhook 200 "user-agent: sample/0.1"
2026-07-04T14:12:01Z INFO  payload {"user":"bob","key":"sk_live_ABC\u200DDEF456"}
2026-07-04T14:12:01Z INFO  reqid=xyz-1 handled payload (redacted)
```
first log shows RequestId=null; the raw payload print contains a zero-width joiner (\u200D) inside the key so the regex missed it. structured req.log had redaction applied.

ops_lee: likely two separate issues: (1) our console shim (which wraps global console and attaches a write hook for redaction) is installed after async otel init so early prints escape, (2) redaction regex doesn't normalize unicode before matching.

raj_sdk: agreed. quick fixes: call `ConsoleShim.installSync()` at top of `rws.init()` before any awaits, and normalise incoming strings with `s = s.replace(/[\u200B-\u200D\uFEFF]/g, '')` or use `normalize('NFKC')` before running redaction. also add an opt-in flag `init({earlyConsoleShim:true})` to not change default behaviour until we validate in CI.

marina_onboard: i patched local rws.init to call a tiny sync shim first; retested and first log now shows reqid and the key replaced with `[REDACTED]`. good signal.

ops_lee: follow-ups: (A) add a stdout/stderr write fallback that applies redaction regex to any chunk before writing to fd in case other libs call process.stdout.write directly, (B) add a regression e2e that starts the sample image and greps stdout for unredacted token patterns during startup.

raj_sdk: long-term: unify redaction behavior across layers (logger wrapper, console shim, low-level write) and make unicode-normalization part of canonical pattern processing so users don't have to craft exotic regexes. also add language parity tasks for python/go.

ci-bot: created task RW-6120: "early console shim + stdout write fallback + unicode-normalise redaction + quickstart note" assigned to raj_sdk, severity=P2. also created RW-6121 for SDK parity (python/go).

marina_onboard: i'll attach the tiny repro and before/after logs to RW-6120. one doc suggestion: quickstart should say "call rws.init() before any direct console.log or framework-level logging; if you must log early, use rws.logger."

raj_sdk: we'll add a one-paragraph quickstart edit and a tiny snippet showing recommended order. thanks for reporting — solid catch on unicode trickery.

marina_onboard: marked resolved locally. will watch CI e2e once RW-6120 lands. :+1:
